subject: The one mistake 92% of couples make with date planning
preview_text: I discovered this secret after watching 230+ couples use SoulPlan. It's the difference between 'meh' and 'wow' dates.
body_paragraphs: Confession time: I almost didn't send this email. Because I was watching how couples use SoulPlan and saw the same pattern over and over. A pattern that leads directly to the 'routine trap' we're all trying to escape. It's not what you think.

The #1 mistake? Planning dates alone. Seriously. When one person does all the work, the magic gets lost. The other person feels like a passenger, not a co-pilot. The spark doesn't come from a perfect plan—it comes from building it together. That's the secret the happiest couples in our community discovered.

That's why the Shared Wishlist feature exists. It's not just a list. It's a conversation starter. A place where 'I'd love to try that' turns into 'Let's do it next Friday.' It's where you discover your partner secretly wants to go stargazing or try that weird fusion restaurant. This one feature alone has created more 'wow' dates than anything else in the app.

Open SoulPlan right now and add just ONE thing to your Shared Wishlist. It takes 30 seconds. Then nudge your partner to add theirs. I promise you'll discover something new about them. P.S. The couples who use the Shared Wishlist have 3x more 'remember when' moments. Don't let your next great date idea stay in your head.
